intro_line: White city where Atlantic waves meet Moorish gates.
intro: Casablanca rewards visitors who look past the business suits to the old medina, the great mosque and the ocean corniche. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Tram line runs 05:30-22:30; one ride about 6-8 MAD with a rechargeable card.
Al Bidaoui train links the airport and some city stops, but stops are far apart.
Buses are cheap at about 5 MAD but routes are unclear and pickpockets are a risk.
Red petits taxis use meters; minimum fare 7 MAD, and drivers may pick up others.
White grand taxis run fixed routes and leave only when full; cheaper for long trips.
Ride apps like Careem and inDrive work; walking is fine in the centre and medina.

airports.name: Mohammed V International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, 23 km southeast of the centre.

options.note: Hourly, leaves at 50 past the hour; slow security check after the train.
Agree the fare first; around 280 MAD as of late 2022.
